scope: 40 primary runs, with six additional mean-fusion runs supporting the matched three-seed ablation

tables.caption_latex: Five-replicate comparison of CLCRN-AGF and the schedule-matched CLCRN control. Values are mean$\pm$sample standard deviation across seeds 2021--2025. Differences are CLCRN-AGF minus control; negative values favour CLCRN-AGF. Confidence intervals and two-sided $p$-values use Welch's unequal-variance approximation.
tables.content_change: Updated all 40-run means, sample SDs, differences, Welch CIs and p-values; BH q-values retained in CSV and the note.

tables.caption_latex: Contextual test results on the same test split. Persistence is deterministic; control and CLCRN-AGF are means across five seeds. All methods use the same zero-inclusive, spatially unweighted evaluation over the full 12-hour forecast. Lower is better.
tables.content_change: Restricted contextual comparison to current Persistence, control and AGF results; no unmatched historical single runs or external values.

tables.caption_latex: Component ablations with a matched 100-epoch FP32 training protocol. All entries report mean$\pm$sample standard deviation over seeds 2023--2025 on the full 12-hour test forecast. Lower is better.
tables.content_change: Used three variants, two tasks and three matched seeds trained for 100 epochs in FP32; removed the unavailable 20-epoch screening block.

tables.caption_latex: Gate-activation statistics pooled over all five CLCRN-AGF seeds and the full test set. The gate balances a graph-aggregated projection and a residual linear projection of the same input, before CLConv. Standard deviations describe the pooled population of scalar gates.
tables.content_change: Included all four tasks and all channels across the full test set for five seeds; distinguished pooled population SD from between-seed SD.
